items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: My daddy knew Joe Oliver very well.

ctx.x: By the way, uh, did you ever know where Joe Oliver was from?

My daddy knew Joe Oliver very well. He used to always tell me about Joe Oliver, how he was, uh, he used to eat so much, and how he was bragging on how much coffee and things he could drink always more than anybody. And, uh, I remember one time that he told me he was staying on 4th Street. And that was about around 1915, because my daddy used to always talk to me about, because it looked like he thought I had an inclination for music, playing music, you see. And he was a guitar player, you see. And, uh, he used to…
You say he worked on the riverfront, was he a longshoreman?
